description: Helper functions for testing parallel checkout operations in a Git-related project. Includes functions to configure checkout settings, verify the number of workers used, and validate checkout integrity.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets the checkout worker and threshold configuration for parallel checkout testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command and verifies that the expected number of checkout worker processes are started.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the checkout completed successfully by checking diff and status.
